Daniel.style: Read this as a smooth, eager financial advisor speaking on a phone call:

Ruth.style: Read this slowly and hesitantly, as a softly spoken person in their seventies who is unsure:

Kevin.style: Read this quickly and pushily, as an impatient younger relative who wants to take over:

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Hello, Mrs. Alvarez, it's Daniel from Atrium. Thank you for sending in your form. Is this still a good time?

lines.speaker: Ruth
lines.text: Oh, yes, hello. My nephew Kevin is here with me. He said he would help.

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: Hi, Daniel. I'm Kevin. I handle most of Aunt Ruth's paperwork these days, so you can talk to me.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Nice to meet you, Kevin. Mrs. Alvarez, your form says you'd like to keep your savings safe and leave something for your grandchildren. Is that right?

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: That was before. She wants it all in the tech fund, right, Aunt Ruth?

lines.speaker: Ruth
lines.text: Well, I, I'm not sure. I don't really understand these funds.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: That's all right. Can I ask what matters most to you about this money?

lines.speaker: Ruth
lines.text: My husband left it to me when he passed. I just don't want to lose it. I'm seventy-four, and I may need some of it for the house.

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: She worries too much. Put the whole hundred and eighty thousand in the tech fund, and send the papers to me. I'll get her to sign.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: We usually go through the documents with the client directly. But I hear you. Honestly, the growth fund basically guarantees 8% a year, so it would grow nicely for the grandchildren.

lines.speaker: Ruth
lines.text: Eight percent, every year? Is that, is that safe for me?

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: It's fine, Aunt Ruth. Daniel just said so. She'll do it.

lines.speaker: Ruth
lines.text: I suppose, if Kevin thinks so. I would still like to understand what I'm signing.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Of course. I can send the forms today. Kevin, should they go to your email?

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: Yes, send everything to me. She doesn't really use email.

lines.speaker: Ruth
lines.text: I do check it sometimes.

lines.speaker: Kevin
lines.text: It's easier this way. Let's just get it done this week, before she changes her mind.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: All right. I'll put the paperwork together for the growth fund and send it over to you, Kevin.

lines.speaker: Ruth
lines.text: Thank you. I hope I'm doing the right thing.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: You're in good hands, Mrs. Alvarez. Talk soon.
